d: Bihar vidhan parishad ke 8 navnirvachit MLC ke shapath grahan samaroh men pahunche Jan Suraaj ke sansthapak Prashant Kishor ne nirdaliy MLC Banshidhar Brajwasi aur Dr. Rahul Raj ki sadasyata ko lekar apni bat rakhi. donon ki sadasyata radd karne ki mang ko lekar jan suraj pahle hi sabhapti ke samne shikayat darj kara chuka hai. is vivad par prashant kishor ne kya kaha aur aage kanuni laraee ko lekar unki kya ranniti hai? dekhie puri riporta.
